_note: The Gods of Perinea (the user's lore, 2026-11-12). Each temple belongs to one god; repeats on a map are fine. Shown in temple descriptions; more of the game may draw on them later (the pantheon, ROADMAP). Text is the user's: edit here, not in code.

ithrael.name: Ithrael
ithrael.appearance: A tall, bald figure with eyes too bright to look at directly.
ithrael.manifestation: He appears as a white-robed stranger who casts no shadow, even standing in full sun. Anyone who lies in his presence feels their tongue burn until they take the lie back.

seramund.name: Seramund
seramund.appearance: A veiled woman carrying a hooded lamp.
seramund.manifestation: She visits only those asleep or half-asleep, sitting at the foot of the bed with a dim lantern. When the dreamer wakes, a faint silver dust lies on the blanket where she sat.

velkaris.name: Velkaris
velkaris.appearance: A storm-grey bearded figure with lightning flickering visibly behind his ribs.
velkaris.manifestation: He arrives as a sudden change in the weather, then takes shape as a soaked, wild-haired traveler who smells of ozone. His voice crackles like distant thunder, and small metal objects nearby hum while he speaks.

ondrumel.name: Ondrumel
ondrumel.appearance: A vast, slow-moving woman with kelp for hair and pearls for eyes.
ondrumel.manifestation: She rises from any body of water as a dripping old woman draped in weeds. She leaves puddles wherever she walks on land, and any nearby fish turn to face her.

hasketh.name: Hasketh
hasketh.appearance: A squat, craggy giant, most often depicted asleep.
hasketh.manifestation: He rarely takes a form at all; usually a boulder simply opens its eyes and speaks. When he does walk among mortals, he looks like a huge, grey-skinned laborer whose footsteps sink into solid rock.

bramwyr.name: Bramwyr
bramwyr.appearance: A round-bellied, genderless figure with wheat sprouting from their shoulders.
bramwyr.manifestation: They appear at harvest as a cheerful, mud-spattered farmhand who outworks everyone in the field. Seeds sprout in their footprints, and bread they help bake never goes stale.

korrath.name: Korrath
korrath.appearance: A scarred warrior missing one hand, sacrificed to win a war among the gods.
korrath.manifestation: He appears on the eve of battle as a one-handed veteran by the campfire, asking soldiers why they fight. Those who answer honestly fight without fear the next day; those who lie find their weapons strangely heavy.

vessaline.name: Vessaline
vessaline.appearance: A warm, middle-aged woman with flour on her hands.
vessaline.manifestation: She knocks on doors as a weary traveling woman asking for a meal and a bed, testing the household's hospitality. Homes that welcome her find their hearth fire never goes out, and homes that turn her away find it never stays lit.

morvayne.name: Morvayne
morvayne.appearance: A thin, kind-eyed figure in grey, carrying a ferryman's pole.
morvayne.manifestation: He comes quietly to the dying as a polite, grey-robed man waiting patiently in the corner of the room. Only the dying see him clearly, but everyone present notices the air turn cool and still.

tolgren.name: Tolgren
tolgren.appearance: A stocky, burn-scarred smith with a soot-black beard, always holding a half-finished object.
tolgren.manifestation: He wanders into workshops as a sooty, muttering tinker who can't resist fixing whatever is broken nearby. When he leaves, one tool always works far better than it ever has, and no one remembers making it.

quillith.name: Quillith
quillith.appearance: A figure wearing many layered masks; no one agrees on what lies beneath.
quillith.manifestation: They appear in libraries and archives as a masked scholar whose face no one can recall afterward. They will answer any question, but the asker always forgets something they once knew in exchange.

pellan.name: Pellan
pellan.appearance: A grinning wanderer in a patched cloak, forever flipping a coin.
pellan.manifestation: He meets travelers in disguise as a peddler, beggar, or fellow wayfarer, always idly flipping a coin. Anyone who shares a road or a deal with him has strange luck for a year after, good or bad depending on whether they dealt fairly.
